svg.data-operating-temp: up to 60 C maximum ambient (PXC and PXO, user guide specifications)

g.data-description: USB-B: an Android device connects here, through a USB OTG cable, as a local display
g.title: usb-b

g.data-description: USB-A: an iOS device connects here as a local display
g.title: usb-a

g.data-description: SENSOR: for environmental sensors only; labelled and framed yellow. A sensor bus: RS-485 and a 1-wire signal, and 12 V power
g.title: sensor

g.data-description: the four navigation buttons and the reset button of the controller
g.title: reset

g.data-description: circle: OK, selects an entry; also shows the main menu
g.title: button-ok

g.data-description: cross: Back; also switches between the automatic and the manual mode
g.title: button-back
